diagram_math_checks.result: Three strands join three ordered bottom and top positions, numbered 1,2,3 in the transported one-based model of local supplier thm-the-braid-group-surjects-onto-the-symmetric-group. Its referenced permutation definition composes rightmost first; the Remarks stacks the rightmost factor at the bottom. The Artin-presentation definition fixes no geometric sign convention, so the explicitly stated lower-left-over-lower-right convention introduces no conflict.

Each level swaps positions i and i+1, leaving the third strand vertical. The descending diagonal is drawn first; the ascending lower-i to upper-(i+1) diagonal is drawn over it with a white clearing stroke. Both panels consistently use this convention. Reversing only the over/under choice represents the inverse crossing; cancellation with the drawn crossing is the two-crossing Reidemeister-II cancellation.

diagram_math_checks.result: Left panel bottom-to-top indices are 1,2,1; right panel indices are 2,1,2. Label initial strands A,B,C from left to right. Left intermediate orders are BAC, BCA, CBA; crossing over pairs are A over B, A over C, B over C. Right intermediate orders are ACB, CAB, CBA; over pairs are B over C, A over C, A over B. Thus both diagrams have the same pairwise over order and differ by Reidemeister III; their word labels exactly match the relation in Example and Artin supplier.

Following either diagram from bottom to top gives 1 to 3, 2 to 2, 3 to 1. Each generator level forgets to adjacent transposition (1 2) or (2 3), exactly as local supplier [L2]. In rightmost-first composition both (1 2)(2 3)(1 2) and (2 3)(1 2)(2 3) exchange 1 and 3 and fix 2, hence equal (1 3).
